headline: Palimpsest's public ledgers have a current integrity-anchor reading
dek: Merkle roots, timestamp proofs and archive witnesses let readers check whether the published record changed.

claims.statement: A current aggregate integrity-anchor record is published for the Palimpsest ledgers.

method.summary: Merkle roots over committed ledgers with external timestamp witnesses

limitations: An integrity witness can detect later alteration of the sealed record; it does not independently validate every underlying claim.
